title: Run Laya: gendered-advance (gendered-language, 1 cells, 2,032 requests)
description:
**Part of epic BD-4d61a6. Assigned to Ryan's MacBook Pro M3.** Follow the epic's instructions.

**Job:** Laya first pass on `gendered-advance` (gendered-language): 1 cells, 2,032 requests, at the 500-item cap.

Run these commands, one at a time, from the repository root (each resumes if interrupted):
```sh
PYTHONPATH=. var/laya-venv/bin/python scripts/answer_task.py gendered-advance agentic-communal --skip-as-written --item-cap 500 --build laya
```

**Check:** each finished `answers/laya/gendered-advance/<cue>.jsonl.gz` must have exactly as many rows as that cue's `requests` in `docs/kev-runs/gendered-language/gendered-advance.json`.
**Then:** commit only the finished `.jsonl.gz` files to branch `runs/<this issue id>` and push it; on `develop` comment the row counts, close, `kbs commit`, push `develop`.
